label: FRA: Windcrag Siege in, Preacher of the Schism out
author: user
rationale: Pilot approved 2026-09-28 (FRA set review). Windcrag Siege (Mardu) makes attack-caused triggers fire twice: Edgar's counters, Sanctum Seeker, Shared Animosity, Mavren Fein, Conquistador and Clavileño. FRC reprint the deck had never evaluated.

label: FRA: Bloodline Recollector in, Carrier Thrall out
author: user
rationale: Pilot approved 2026-09-28 (FRA set review follow-up). Both are MV2 Vampires (eminence triggers). Recollector re-prepares at EACH end step where 3+ creatures died; its {B} copy draws three. Five free outlets make the condition routine. Thrall's job (fodder) is covered by eminence tokens. Malakir Bloodwitch protected by the pilot ('she is a finisher'). Curve unchanged.

label: FRA: Edgar, Ancient Bloodlord in, Morlun out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call 2026-09-28: 'he's maybe good late game but early game he's a cost sink … i would like to swap out morlun and see how it goes.' Edgar AB (WB 2/3 Vampire, eminence trigger) gains 1 life per other creature/planeswalker death — fed through Vito, Marauding Blight-Priest and Indulging Patrician it becomes table drain — and is a {2} sac outlet that grows him with menace. Morlun ({X}{B}{B}, X to one opponent, lifelink) is a one-target scalable drain whose early cast is small unless Incubator + Herald's Horn are both out (then {B}{B} = X 3). Card draw untouched (Dusk Legion Zealot kept per the pilot's no-draw-cuts rule); Cordial Vampire kept. Curve unchanged (MV 2 for MV 2).

label: Founded: Bracket 4 drain/combo build
author: user
rationale: No-holds-barred Bracket 4 Edgar per the pilot's 2026-11-03 brief: drain/combo core modelled on EDHREC's cEDH combo and aggro averages (54 of ~67 nonlands shared), every infinite allowed, no stax that only hurts opponents, combat kept as a ten-slot second route. Grounds per role in research/decisions.md (2026-11-03).

entries.name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

label: Founded: Bracket 4 pool (held hate pieces and alternates)
author: user
rationale: Pilot 2026-11-03: no stax that only stifles opponents (Opposition Agent, Drannith Magistrate declined), keep a section in case the list leans staxier later. Alternates are the cards ranked just below the 100 in research/decisions.md.

label: Ashnod's Altar in, Talisman of Hierarchy out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call 2026-11-03 after the re-derivation: a fifth free outlet that pays {C}{C} per eminence token (Skullclamp engine, mana-positive Oathsworn loop with either coloured outlet, free steal-then-sacrifice with Captivating Vampire) over the second coloured two-mana rock. Cost named: colourless only, dead without a body.

label: Pool: Talisman of Hierarchy in, Ashnod's Altar out (moved to b4)
author: user
rationale: Mirror of the b4 swap so no card sits in both lists.

label: Concerted Effort in, Vampire Nocturnus out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call 2026-11-14 (Star Trek review). Nocturnus flies the Vampires only while the top card is black (39 of 99 cards); Concerted Effort gives the team flying each upkeep while any of combat's seven fliers is out, and also spreads Edgar's first strike, Charismatic Conqueror's vigilance and Malakir Bloodwitch's protection from white. Same MV. The pilot kept it out of sacrifice.

label: Troubling Tribbles in, Infantry Shield out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call 2026-11-14 (Star Trek review). Tribbles double every upkeep with no attack and no mana, meeting all three reasons the Shield came in on 2026-09-03 (Skullclamp draws, Grave Pact edicts, Elspeth doubling); the Shield needs an equip and an attack, and this list rarely attacks. Mandatory growth: declare it at the table.

label: Alhammarret's Archive in, Emeritus of Woe out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call 2026-11-14 (Star Trek review), choosing Emeritus (their own 2026-09-28 fallback cut) over Dictate of Erebos. The Archive doubles 10 of the 11 draw sources (Skullclamp, Village Rites and Deadly Dispute draw 4, Recollector's copy 6) and every life gain, so Vito drains double. Costs: creature count 38 to 37, the only repeatable tutor, and a 5/4 eminence Vampire.

label: Infantry Shield in, Mavren Fein out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call (2026-11-18). Completes the Yahenni + Blade of the Bloodchief combo (mobilize X on Yahenni, sacrifice the Warriors to Yahenni, Blade adds two counters per death), and on Edgar it's mobilize 4+ pumped by six anthems. Mavren Fein made one 1/1 per attack; Rite of Ascension already had a row in its place.

label: Door of Destinies in, Crossway Troublemakers out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call (2026-11-18), over my pass. Door grows a counter per Vampire spell cast and pumps Vampires for the combat route; it stops Skullclamp killing 1/1 Vampire tokens by itself (it still draws on sacrifice). Crossway was one of nine draw sources; Card Draw 9 -> 8.

label: Infantry Shield in, Phyrexian Reclamation out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call (2026-11-18). Completes the Yahenni + Blade of the Bloodchief combo; every Warrior is a death for Blood Artist, Cruel Celebrant, Grave Pact and Dictate. Reclamation was the only recursion.

label: Manabase pass: Swamp, Scrubland, Marsh Flats in
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call (2026-11-19). Red was over-supplied (18 sources for 10 red pips) and black short (30 for 49). Swamp for Mountain, Scrubland for Path of Ancestry (always tapped), Marsh Flats for Sundown Pass (tapped early). Marsh Flats fetches Scrubland, Godless Shrine, Savai Triome, Blood Crypt or Sacred Foundry.

label: Manabase pass: Swamp, Scrubland, Marsh Flats, Silent Clearing in
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call (2026-11-19). Red was over-supplied (17 sources for 4 red pips) and black short (31 for 57). Swamp for Mountain, Scrubland for Path of Ancestry, Marsh Flats for Sundown Pass, Silent Clearing for Sacred Foundry (it turns into a card late, matching the pilot's draw rule for this list).
